verdict.rationale: Mercury publishes an official, first-party MCP server at https://mcp.mercury.com/mcp, with dedicated docs on what it is, how to connect it as a custom connection, which tools it supports, and security practices such as revoking access from the dashboard. It exposes accounts, transactions, recipients and cards to AI assistants and answers natural-language queries; a probe confirms the docs exist. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server, and detailed evidence of the full tool list (including MCP-specific write actions) and the authentication flow.
